help.character.tile.description: There are <bold>15 Character tiles</bold> grouped into <bold>5 different suits</bold> recognizable by their colors. Only <bold>12 tiles are in play per game</bold>.
help.character.tile.rallying.description: The locations hold the characters you will <bold>share with your opponent</bold>. Rallying the characters will be <bold>different depending on where they are</bold>. Whenever you meet a location's condition, you take the corresponding character at the end of the turn, <bold>always after resolving all actions</bold>.
help.character.tile.end.description: The game ends at the end of a turn, as soon as you or your opponent meet <bold>one of these two victory conditions</bold>:
help.character.tile.end.condition.1: owning <bold>3 characters in the same suit</bold>.
help.character.tile.end.condition.2: owning at least <bold>1 character of each of the 5 suits</bold>.
help.character.tile.end.victory: The player who ended the game this way <bold>immediately wins the game</bold>.
help.character.tile.end.other: If the last character of a location is rallied <bold>and none</bold> of these victory conditions is met, <bold>the game immediately ends</bold>. In this case, the winner is the player who has the <bold>most prestige stars on characters</bold> they have rallied. Gain <bold>1 extra Prestige point</bold> if you have a Special Action tile on your side of the board, and <bold>1 extra Prestige point</bold> for each Special Action tile you have set aside during the game. In case of a <bold>tie</bold>, the player with the <bold>most characters</bold> wins.
help.board.description: The board is divided in 4 areas. All 3 locations (<cabaret>Cabaret</cabaret>, <finance>Finance Center</finance> and <race>Racetrack</race>) host characters. <bold>The Actions area</bold> allows you to exert influence over each of the 3 locations thanks to the different actions.
help.board.actions.1: Place 2 tokens on the Cabaret. The first token you place must be <bold>orthogonally adjacent to another token already in play</bold>. The second token must be <bold>adjacent to the token you just placed</bold>
help.board.actions.2: Place 1 token at the Cabaret. It must be <bold>orthogonally adjacent to another token</bold>. Then, advance your Ascension token in the Finance Center. Your token advances <bold>one space if it is at the same level as your opponent's or higher</bold>. If it is lower, <bold>it advances two spaces</bold>.
help.board.actions.3: Advance your Ascension token in the Finance Center. Your token advances <bold>one space if it is at the same level as your opponent's or higher</bold>. If it is lower, <bold>it advances two spaces</bold>. Then place a token at the Racetrack. It must be placed on a <bold>row that is still available</bold>, and on the <bold>leftmost empty space of that row</bold>.
help.board.actions.4: Place 2 tokens at the Racetrack. They must be placed on <bold>two different rows that are still available</bold>, on the <bold>leftmost empty space of the row</bold>. If there is only one row left, <bold>only place one token</bold>.
help.board.actions.special: Dorothy and James also have a personal space on their side of the Actions area. It receives the <bold>Special Action tiles players may obtain during the game</bold>.
help.board.bonus: On each location, you will find <bonus>bonus spaces</bonus> that grant extra effects when you reach them
help.cabaret.description.1: To obtain characters in the Cabaret, you must place your Influence tokens on the right spaces! Forming a continuous path from one edge of the board to the opposite edge with orthogonally adjacent Influence tokens in your color allows you to obtain, at the end of the turn, the matching character.
help.cabaret.description.2: The bottom character is obtained with the <star/> spaces.
help.cabaret.description.3: If you occupy all 4 <star/> spaces with your Influence tokens, you rally the character at the end of the turn.
help.cabaret.description.4: Each time you place a token in the Cabaret, it must be orthogonally adjacent to another token, whoever the owner of that token is.
help.finance.description.1: At the Finance Center, you make your Ascension token progress in the building, from the bottom towards the top. If your token reaches or moves over a character, you rally them at the end of the turn. Doing so, you will reveal a bonus space your opponent can benefit from, as a compensation, when they reach or move over that space.
help.finance.description.2: Each time your Ascension token progresses in the Finance Center, by any means, you climb 1 space if your token is at the same level or higher than your opponent's Ascension token. If your token is lower than your opponent's, it climbs 2 spaces instead of one.
help.race.description.1: At the Racetrack, you place your tokens on the tracks to win majorities. Each time you play a token there, place it on a track that is still available, on the leftmost empty space. Once a track is complete, at the end of a turn, the player with the most tokens on that track wins the corresponding tile. It is possible, in a single turn, to complete a track and change the majority of that track, for example with bonuses.
help.race.description.2: Once the character has been taken, give back all tokens on this track to their owners and place a Race Finished overlay tile on the corresponding track. This track becomes unavailable for the remainder of the game and no one can place any tokens on it.
help.bonus.description: On all 3 locations, spaces with bonuses can be found. At the Cabaret and the Racetrack, apply a bonus as soon <bold>as you place a token on it</bold>. At the Finance Center, apply a bonus as soon as you reach it or move over it. These bonuses are always optional
help.bonus.bonus.1: Your Ascension token advances one space towards the top of the Finance Center. It moves up one space if it is at the same level as your opponent's or higher. It moves up two spaces if it is below.
help.bonus.bonus.2: At the beginning of your opponent's next turn, choose which action they must play. It may be their special action, if they have one. The tile must be discarded after use. You may not choose the action you just took this way.
help.bonus.bonus.3: Swap one of your Influence tokens with an Influence token from your opponent. You may swap tokens from the same location, or from 2 different locations. Swapping tokens does not reactivate bonuses.
help.bonus.bonus.4: Place one of your Influence tokens at the Cabaret or at the Racetrack. At the Cabaret, it must be adjacent to any token already in play. At the Racetrack, it must be placed on the leftmost empty space of any row of your choosing that is still available.
help.bonus.bonus.5:
Take 2 characters from the board. They can be face up and/or face down, and they can come from different locations. Secretly look at any face down characters, and keep their identity secret.
You may then choose to swap their places without changing their state (face up stays face up, face down stays face down). If both characters were face down, do not tell your opponent whether you have swapped them or not.
help.bonus.bonus.6: Draw 3 Special Action tiles, choose one and place it in your dedicated space of the board. Discard the 2 other tiles. If you already had a Special Action on your dedicated space, you may keep it or place the newly selected Special Action tile in its place. In any case, you can only have one Special Action tile. Set aside the tile you do not wish to keep. It may be worth 1 Prestige point at the end of the game.
help.actiontoken.description: The Action token identifies <bold>the action you wish to perform</bold>. It has 2 sides, one for Dorothy and one for James.
help.ascensiontoken.description: The Ascension token allows you to climb the stories of the Finance Center.
help.cabarettile.description: The 4 Cabaret tiles are shuffled at the beginning of the game and <bold>randomly placed</bold> in the Cabaret space.
help.influencetoken.description: Influence tokens allow you to play in the <bold>Cabaret</bold> or the <bold>Racetrack</bold>.
help.raceFinishedOverlay.description.1: The Race Finished overlay tile is placed on a track once the corresponding character has been taken.
help.raceFinishedOverlay.description.2: This track becomes <bold>unavailable for the remainder of the game</bold> and no one can place any tokens on it.
help.SpecialActionTile.description.1: There are <bold>11 different</bold> Special Action tiles
help.SpecialActionTile.description.2: When you pick up a Special Action tile, you must place it in your character's dedicated space (left for Dorothy, right for James).
help.SpecialActionTile.description.3: If you already had a Special Action on your dedicated space, you may keep it or place the newly selected Special Action tile in its place. In any case, <bold>you can only have one Special Action tile</bold>. Set aside the tile you do not wish to keep.
help.SpecialActionTile.description.4: At the end of the game, the <bold>tiles set aside</bold> and the <bold>remaining tile on the dedicated space</bold> earn 1 Prestige point <bold>each</bold>.
help.SpecialActionTile.action.1: Place 1 Influence token at the Racetrack, on an empty space of your choice.
help.SpecialActionTile.action.2: Swap one of your Influence tokens with one of your opponent's Influence tokens. Then place an Influence token on the Racetrack, on an available row, on its leftmost free space.
help.SpecialActionTile.action.3: Place 3 Influence tokens at the Racetrack on 3 different available rows. If there are less than 3 available rows, only place a token on the available row(s).
help.SpecialActionTile.action.4: Place 2 Influence tokens on a single available row of the Racetrack, on the 2 leftmost empty spaces.
help.SpecialActionTile.action.5: Swap 2 Character tiles, then advance your Ascension token in the Finance Center. Finally, swap 1 of your Influence tokens with one of your opponent's Influence tokens. You must take those 3 actions in that order.
help.SpecialActionTile.action.6: Advance your Ascension token in the Finance Center twice. If the first move puts you on the same level or higher than your opponent, the second move only progresses you one space up.
help.SpecialActionTile.action.7: Place 1 Influence token at the Cabaret, adjacent to a token already in play, whoever its owner is. Then advance your Ascension token in the Finance Center. Then place 1 Influence token at the Racetrack, on the leftmost empty space of an available track. You must take those 3 actions in that order.
help.SpecialActionTile.action.8: Place 1 Influence token at the Cabaret, on the empty space of your choice.
help.SpecialActionTile.action.9: Place 1 Influence token at the Cabaret. It must be orthogonally adjacent to another token already in play, whoever their owner is. Then swap one of your Influence tokens with one of your opponent's Influence tokens.
help.SpecialActionTile.action.10: Place 3 Influence tokens at the Cabaret. The first must be adjacent to a token already in play. The second one must be adjacent to the first, and the third, adjacent to the second.
help.SpecialActionTile.action.11: Place 2 Influence tokens at the Cabaret. Each must be adjacent to a token in play, but the tokens you place this way do not have to be adjacent.

tuto.step.1: In Gatsby, you play as Dorothy or James and compete for the attention of the legendary Jay Gatsby.
tuto.step.2: Your objective is to attract the characters, represented by these 12 tiles, to you.
tuto.step.3: On your turn, you must take the <bold>Action token</bold> and place it on one of the available actions.
tuto.step.4: Since you go first, your opponent chooses a Special Action tile.
tuto.step.5: He also has an <bold>Influence token</bold> in the Cabaret.
tuto.step.6: Your turn: place the <bold>Action token</bold> on this action.
tuto.step.7:
The two corresponding actions are performed in order, from left to right.
The first action consists of placing an <bold>Influence token</bold> in the Cabaret.
tuto.step.8: The Cabaret is located here. These 3 <bold>Character tiles</bold> can be obtained in this location.
tuto.step.9:
Your <bold>Influence token</bold> must be placed next to an existing token.
Place your token at the bottom right of James's.
tuto.step.10:
By placing your token on a bonus, you immediately obtain the corresponding action.
Here you get a free action at the Finance Center.
tuto.step.11: This is the Finance Center. These 4 <bold>Character tiles</bold> can be obtained here.
tuto.step.12: An action at the Finance Center allows you to raise your <bold>Ascension token</bold> by one floor... <bold>or 2 floors if your opponent's Ascension token is higher than yours!</bold>
tuto.step.13:
When your token reaches a bonus, you get it immediately.
Here, you will be able to secretly consult 2 Character tiles and put them back in place, or swap them. <bold>Note that face down tiles will remain hidden</bold>.
Click on "Advance in the Finance Center".
tuto.step.15: Return the 2 tiles to the board.
tuto.step.16: Your first action, at the Cabaret, is over.
tuto.step.17: To get this character in the Cabaret, you must have a continuous line of tokens running from the upper left edge to the lower right edge.
tuto.step.18: For this character, it's the opposite.
tuto.step.19:
To obtain this character, you must have a token on the 4 <gearing/> spaces of the Cabaret.
Your opponent already controls one, but it is possible to take it from them with the bonus action <swap/> which is found in different places on the board. It allows you to swap 2 Influence tokens.
tuto.step.20: Now you play your second action, in the Finance Center: your <bold>Ascension token</bold> goes up another floor.
tuto.step.21:
It's James' turn, so the Action token is turned over.
Your opponent is forced to choose an action different from yours.
tuto.step.22: Your opponent has placed 2 Influence tokens, <bold>adjacent</bold>, in the Cabaret.
tuto.step.23: Up to you. Choose this action.
tuto.step.24: By going up to the Finance Center, you obtained your first <bold>Character tile</bold>, which you will collect at the end of your turn.
tuto.step.25: If you get <bold>3 Characters of the same suit</bold> or <bold>1 Character of each of the 5 suits</bold>, you immediately win the game!
tuto.step.26: If the other player reaches the same floor in the Finance Center, they can no longer obtain a character, but they will get a free action in the Cabaret or the Racetrack instead.
tuto.step.27:
Your second action takes place here, at the Racetrack.
You can collect these <bold>5 Character tiles</bold> there.
tuto.step.28: An action at the Racetrack allows you to place an <bold>Influence token</bold> on one of the tracks, in the leftmost free space.
tuto.step.29: The track is complete when all spaces are occupied by Influence tokens. The player with the most tokens on the track then wins the character at the end of the track.
tuto.step.30:
These tiles are the <bold>Special Action tiles</bold>.
You take one of 3 when you get this bonus: <special/>.
You can only have one Special Action tile, but if you obtain another, you set aside the one of your choice: it will earn <bold>1 Prestige point</bold> at the end of the game.
tuto.step.31:
The game ends immediately when a player has <bold>three characters of the same suit</bold> (color), or <bold>a character of each of the 5 suits</bold>.
Otherwise, the game ends when <bold>a location no longer has any characters</bold>. In this case, the winner is the player with <bold>the most Prestige points</bold>.
<bold>Each star</bold> on a character earns <bold>1 Prestige point</bold>.
Each <bold>unused Special Action tile</bold> also earns <bold>1 Prestige point</bold>.
tuto.step.32:
Now it's your turn, choose the track of your choice to end your turn.
Good luck!
